Thanks for the heads-up, Amelia — we can accommodate a shift. Two logistical notes before we lock a time:
1) We recommend keeping the hands-on (prompt review + routing + small load test) under 90 minutes for the first session. If you want a separate deep load test, we can schedule that for a follow-up.
2) For the 15–20 minute peak you mentioned (120 concurrent, ~1.2k tokens avg) we suggest requesting a temporary quota bump: target 250k tokens/min burst and a concurrency window of 150 concurrent connections. If you go Dedicated for the trial we can provision a short-term reserved pool; otherwise on Hosted we'll apply a time-limited quota increase.

Options (attached): pilot_quota_options.pdf outlines three trial configurations and estimated cost deltas. I also attached a dry_run_checklist.md that'll make the session run smoothly.

Subject: RE: Pilot kickoff — dry-run & quota alignment (reschedule request)

We can do the temporary quota bump for a 48–72 hour window. Quick notes:
- For the test profile (120 concurrent, ~1.2k tokens avg) request a burst allowance of 250k tokens/min and a soft rate limit of 2k reqs/min. That maps to the medium trial tier in the attachment.
- Dedicated short-term reserved pool: operationally simple but requires a short write-up and approval in our capacity queue. If customer wants zero variability, Dedicated is the better path.
- Hosted bump: faster to approve for trials but subject to global pooling; it's appropriate for day-of load tests where absolute isolation isn’t required.

I attached the quota_bump_request_form.pdf — Olga, if you can confirm the exact test window and whether Greenfield wants Dedicated isolation I'll submit the request to infra.

— Marcus
